issue_context.title: UI configured utility_meter does not start collecting until HA is restarted
issue_context.body:
### Checklist

- [X] I have updated to the latest available Home Assistant version.
- [X] I have cleared the cache of my browser.
- [X] I have tried a different browser to see if it is related to my browser.

### Describe the issue you are experiencing

The new UI config flow for Utility Meter is not mentioning that a restart of home assistant is needed to activate the sensor. Can this be added to the printscreen below?

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/74881023/161241572-1d5f0e2a-4a2c-422d-841d-c0911f7986a6.png)


### Describe the behavior you expected

The config flow UI should mention that a restart is needed.

### Steps to reproduce the issue

1. Go to helpers
2. Create a utility helper
3. Look at the popup screen

### What version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

core-2022.4.0b1

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

_No response_

### In which browser are you experiencing the issue with?

Google Chrome 99.0.4844.84 (64bit)

### Which operating system are you using to run this browser?

Windows 11

_No response_

comments: This is not a frontend issue.

Hey there @dgomes, mind taking a look at this issue as it has been labeled with an integration (`utility_meter`) you are listed as a [code owner](https://github.com/home-assistant/core/blob/dev/CODEOWNERS#L1089) for? Thanks!
<sub><sup>(message by CodeOwnersMention)</sup></sub>
No restart of Home Assistant should be needed to activate the utility meter, can you please explain in some more detail what did not work until you restarted Home Assistant?

Questions from GitHub beta channel:
_What was the initial setup (utility_meter already configured through YAML or not)_: New sensor added through GUI

_What was filled in in the config flow?_
Create utiltiy_meter with following settings in GUI:
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/28803438/161252878-3e430f6a-22f4-4d85-8b51-62b5da001a72.png)

_What did you expect would happen?_ 
A sensor with state `0` and status `collecting`. I needed a reboot to get to that state as shown below:
```yaml
state_class: total_increasing
source: sensor.water_usage_liter
status: collecting
last_period: '0'
meter_period: hourly
cron pattern: 0 * * * *
last_reset: '2022-04-01T11:16:51.344190+00:00'
icon: mdi:counter
friendly_name: Water Hourly
```

_What happened instead?_
Pressing submit resulted in a sensor with state `unknown` and the following attributes:
```yaml
state_class: total_increasing
source: sensor.water_usage_liter
status: paused
last_period: '0'
meter_period: hourly
cron pattern: 0 * * * *
last_reset: '2022-04-01T11:15:30.677898+00:00'
icon: mdi:counter
friendly_name: Water Hourly
```

What was filled in in the config flow?

Making a new test utility meter like so

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/22405505/161252931-ea8cdf71-da7f-4137-ad6e-168879015fff.png)

creates the utility sensors  just fine which I can see in dev_tools but they are `paused` and `unknown`. At first I thought this was just becasue the source sensor hadn't updated its state yet (similar to what happens with `integration`) but it definitely has and these are still unknown.

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/22405505/161253374-232926c4-08b0-4beb-804f-07ccb4688bf8.png)

I did also wait some time in case there was a delay. But seems that only after you restart HA they start `collecting` and counting.
Notice also how now after the restart even the off-peak sensor that is paused since its tariff isn't active the state is now 0 instead of unknown.

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/22405505/161253904-47808708-90e4-490f-ae25-2f5b4297ef32.png)

I've created two scenarios as well. 
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/74881023/161254949-10eb039a-25f6-4b84-b1ba-785caf52c140.png)
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/74881023/161254995-8428d3f4-e2f6-42bd-8dbd-9399dd2b9e6d.png)
My source sensor is updating every 10 seconds.
Thanks a lot everyone for adding more details 👍
Thank you for taking the time to write a fix.
